context_image.usage_description: Top three are actual Tibia reference costumes and pixel craft. Bottom is the immutable target Citizen pose. Adopt craft and costume richness, not reference weapons, poses or identical outfit.

description: WILDWARDEN: a distinctive forest guardian with a compact dark-steel stag crown and TWO short forked bone antler prongs; broad cool SLATE-GRAY fur shoulder yoke clearly resting across both shoulders; deep emerald quilted leather torso with a wide bronze belt clasp; dark leather bracers and strapped tall boots. Premium Druid/Norseman/Warmaster character, fresh design. Fur is cool gray, never peach/cream; no dangling bone/cloth near the arms. Bold antler silhouette, readable chest armor, calm dark cloth areas. Native Tibia 8.60 pixel art for a paid original outfit, not a recolor of the starter. Top context images are REAL Tibia costume/pixel-style references only; the bottom CITIZEN is the exact pose target. Keep his fixed face, eyes, two hands, shoulder-elbow-wrist pose and foot positions unchanged. Exactly TWO arms following those original wrist anchors. No additional skin anywhere in the mask. Clearly separate sleeves/bracers from the existing peach hands with dark cuffs. No pale fleshy sleeve panels. New headgear is allowed only in the masked hair/head margin; never redraw a face inside headgear. Same south-facing oblique camera and roughly 32px body, with modest extra headgear height. Rich deliberate 2-3px clusters, strong silhouette, layered shading like the references, dark outlines and upper-left light. Distinct materials, no noisy confetti or smooth antialiasing. No weapons, shields, pets, detached ornaments, glow, shadows, words, panel borders or extra body parts. Transparent background.
